Calculate the 95th percentile latency for the inside payment service APIs over the last 60 minutes, display only results for non-internal spans, and only keep spans whose average latency over the last hour is greater than or equal to 0.01.

answer:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="ts-inside-payment-service", span_kind!="internal"}[60m])) 
  > on(span_name) group_left 
avg_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_latency_sum{service="ts-inside-payment-service", span_kind!="internal"}[60m]) 
  / avg_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_latency_count{service="ts-inside-payment-service", span_kind!="internal"}[60m]) >= 0.01
```
